about: Deterministic price rules for the Review check. Base and add-on prices live in services.json; the fees Spectora adds on its servers are recorded here. Only rules marked confirmed are used: a booking whose price needs an unconfirmed rule, or whose inputs fall outside every rule (or inside two), stops before admission. Ranges use Spectora's semantics: the lower bound is exclusive and the upper bound inclusive ('sqft 500 - 1000' is 501-1000 sq ft); upTo null means 'and above'.
method: Measured on 2026-10-25 against Spectora's own price calculation on the Truss scheduler (POST /api/v1/public/services/{id}/calculate_charge and /service_add_ons/{id}/calculate_charge, the request the page sends at Step 1's NEXT), with the scheduler page open and never past Step 2: no time chosen, no contact entered, nothing submitted. 325 calculations, all HTTP 200, tax $0, recorded one per row in pricing-observations-2026-10-25.csv with Spectora's own fee lines. A rule is confirmed when it was observed at its boundaries and inside it, and Spectora's fee breakdown names the range; a no-fee region is confirmed where it was sampled at its boundaries and across it. The first two rows were first seen from the page's own Step 1 request (1,800 sq ft built 1954 = $425, as on the Phase 0 Review of 2026-10-24; 2,001 sq ft built 1961 slab = $400); the rest repeat that request with other inputs. Base prices matched services.json (Residential $300, 1 Year Warranty $250, New Construction $275, Condo $225); Multi-Family returns $0 'Call for Pricing' and is never booked.

mileageFees.evidence: Spectora adds a fee by its own distance calculation from a starting address (the scheduler's company record gives 2550 E Rose Garden Ln, Phoenix 85050; whether the modifier measures from it or from an inspector's home address is not visible from the scheduler; the observed tiers fit driving distance rather than straight-line distance). The agent cannot reproduce that distance, so a Residential price is computed only in a ZIP listed here and confirmed by the owner as entirely inside the no-fee distance (60 driving miles on the observed ranges). Each ZIP was seen with no fee at one sample address; that is not enough for the whole ZIP, so none is confirmed yet.
